row.evidence: Xactly's pricing page lists Incent Core, Plus and Ultimate with 'Get a Quote' only, and the Okta catalogue lists Xactly for SAML/SWA sign-in with no provisioning; no public SCIM documentation was found.
row.notes: Quote-only: every Incent, Forecasting and Sales Planning package is 'Get a Quote'. No SCIM or SSO setup docs are public; Xactly's customer community (community.xactlycorp.com) redirects to a login page, so status stays unknown rather than none. Okta OIN app is SAML + SWA only. The trust page (trust.xactlycorp.com/security) does not mention SSO or SCIM. Xactly Connect offers ETL/REST data integration, not a documented user-management API.

scim.notes: No public Xactly SCIM documentation found; product documentation sits in the login-only Xactly community.

user_api.notes: Xactly Connect advertises ETL and REST APIs for CRM/ERP/HCM data integration; no public user-management API reference was found.

okta.notes: OIN capabilities read from page markup: SAML and SWA checked; no SCIM or provisioning (last updated Dec. 21 2021).

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com saas-apps xactly-tutorial and xactly-enterprise-tutorial return 404; Learn search finds no Xactly tutorial.

fallbacks.notes: Xactly product documentation is in the customer community, which requires login.
